project.name: 古希腊展览海报
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Ancient Greece exhibition poster, olympic gold + olive green + aegean blue, marble & stone background palette, Cinzel Decorative + Noto Serif, classical luxury museum aesthetic
project.designRead: exhibition poster / museum visitors / classical luxury / low density / avoid neon or modern tech feel

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: Olympic gold #C9A84C used for borders, accents, key text, and decorative elements
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: single brand hue (gold); olive green and terracotta used as contextual accents from cultural palette

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: Sharp geometric edges with meander key patterns, no rounded corners on decorative frames

typographySystem.bodyStack: 'Noto Serif SC', 'Noto Serif', 'Georgia', serif for body text and details

styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: Border-heavy, surface-layered frames inspired by Greek architectural ornament
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: Greek meander/greek key patterns, laurel wreaths, column silhouettes

designSource.designDecisionSummary: Classical Greek palette: olympic gold primary, olive green and terracotta accents, marble white backgrounds, deep charcoal text. Cinzel Decorative display, Noto Serif body. Meander pattern borders, laurel wreath ornaments.

pages.title: 古希腊展览海报
pages.visualNorthStar: Classical Greek museum exhibition poster with marble texture, gold meander borders, and laurel wreath ornaments
pages.compositionPattern: centered vertical poster layout with ornamental frame, hero image, and structured event details grid
